revision_summary: Four quote-timestamp/attribution issues need fixing before this ships: (1) interest_reason_audit.reason_quote at 00:52 is a fabricated composite — it stitches together customer lines from 00:53, 00:58-01:02, and 01:05-01:10 into one continuous quote and silently omits the rep's intervening line ('Yeah. We have an office out there. Okay.'). Rebuild this as either a shorter, single accurate quote or clearly mark it as a paraphrase/summary spanning multiple turns with a ts range (00:53-01:10), not a single ts. (2) script_coverage interest_question row lists customer_quote 'So there's gonna be...' at ts 00:16 — that ts belongs to the rep's question; the customer line is actually spoken ~01:05-01:10 (matches end_ts already listed) — align the quote to the end_ts, not the row's primary ts. (3) script_coverage bill_collection row mistakenly attributes the rep's line 'Sweet. Yeah. I just got that.' (spoken by rep at 05:47) to the customer and anchors it at ts 02:49 (the ask time) — fix speaker attribution and timestamp. (4) script_coverage appointment_set row lists customer_quote 'Maybe seven' at ts 05:50, but that line is spoken at 06:50 — correct the timestamp. None of these are fundamental misreadings (outcome, speaker roles overall, and trajectory verdict remain sound and well-supported), so a full rerun isn't warranted — these are targeted quote/timestamp corrections. Additionally, on revision, tighten the credit-drift claim in cherry_pick_moments[2] to avoid overstating an n=2 pattern as floor-wide drift in the stewart_read (the coaching_implication's softer 'worth confirming' framing is fine and should be the dominant tone throughout that entry). Also consider whether the suggested flip language in cherry_pick_moments[0] ('locked-in solar rate') risks implying an unestablished comparison outcome under numeric_discipline — reword to reference only the customer's own $200 and rate-hike concern without implying a specific solar rate outcome.
